rule: Keep the original torso colour extraction. Estimate illumination from pixels beside the person in the torso-height band (10-55% bbox height), extending from 10% to 100% bbox width on either side. Use green-dominant pixels (G > 1.05R and G > 1.05B) if at least 8 exist, otherwise use all surrounding pixels. Divide colour by median max-channel illumination and multiply by 80; clamp scale to [0.5, 3] and RGB to [0, 255]. Fewer than 8 surrounding pixels or illumination below 20 retains the raw colour. Feed normalized observations into the unchanged median TeamAssigner and preserve normal live anchor ordering.
selection_reason: Grass filtering is the only local-illumination candidate with more correct player assignments and fewer wrong/other-colour assignments. It also increases unassigned players by 13, which must remain visible in reporting.
control_acceptance: More correct player observations, no increase in wrong or other-colour assignments on identical samples. Unassigned losses are reported explicitly. No parameter or method changes after opening control images.
scope_limit: New temporal clips of the same match; single Codex image reviewer, correlated frames. No cross-match generalization or player identity claim.
